'''BG-series droids''' were a model of [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]]. An older model by the time of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], it was believed that all examples of the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] had been destroyed. At least one droid, [[BG-12]], survived and was in the service of the criminal [[Themog]].<ref name="HNNA" />
